player_prompt.intro:
Iwe Player {player_id} mu ndi Negotiation Game.
Inu nkhani zinga, na shani yako ndi kugwiritsa ntchito zinthu zinga kugwiritsa ntchito kwambiri.
Zinthu zinga ndi malipiro ankhani zinga zili pano:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Pa kila nkhondo, inu angathe kuzizwa na mwamene na kuchita ujumbe wa kugwiritsa ntchito.
Tumie zilema zifuza kwa shani:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Zinthu zofunzidwa -> Zinthu zotchedwa]
  - '[Accept]': Kudziwa ujumbe unaozuzidwa.
  - '[Deny]': Kukana ujumbe unaozuzidwa (kawiri).
Ndi ndi {max_turns} nkhondo zose.
